_: How this repository is read against the Quran.ws terminology standard. See https://github.com/quranws/guidelines.
_exclude: work/ is the build's scratch copy of the KFGQPC packages; the two counting files are vendored verbatim from quranpedia/qiraat-ayah-map and are corrected upstream, not here — their English names are replaced on load, see pipeline/qurantext/counting.py. data/ is generated from pipeline/ and the audit already skips it.
_ignore_words: `part` and `parts` are ordinary English here — a part of a word, riwayat that part company — and never the juz.
_external_names: Names this repository does not own: the KFGQPC package, member and font names; the columns of their CSVs; Unicode character names; and the upstream repository. They are quoted, not chosen, so they are read as locators rather than as names. The last four belong to the shared search fold specification in docs/SEARCH-FOLD.md and conformance/search-fold.json: uthmani-hafs.json is a file in the quran-tajweed repository, quran-tajweed is that repository's name on GitHub, Imlaei is Tanzil's own name for the script it publishes, and Tarteel is the organisation named beside QUL in the section 9 survey.
